cycle: Total Cycle Time (Sec) — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
shift: Machine Shift Time (Hour) = Machine Time OFF − Machine Time ON
idealQty: IDEAL Quantity = (Machine Shift Time in min − Lunch / Tea in min) × 60 ÷ Total Cycle Time, shown with no decimals as on the sheet. Actual Quantity can't be more than the whole number under it.
rejectedQty: Rejected Quantity = Actual Quantity − ACTUAL OK Quantity
pctOk: % OK Quantity = ACTUAL OK Quantity ÷ Actual Quantity
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total stoppage (Min) = the ten downtime columns added up, Lunch / Tea / Washroom included.
effective: Effective Machine Run Time (Hour) = ACTUAL OK Quantity × Total Cycle Time ÷ 3600
unreported: Unreported Time (Min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Effective Machine Run Time × 60 − Total stoppage, for this entry. A Planned Operator Shift locked in Process Master counts once for the machine's day, so a locked day is combined across its entries.
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Total stoppage ÷ 60), for this entry (combined across the machine's day on a locked shift).
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses, but lunch = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch ÷ 60), for this entry (combined across the machine's day on a locked shift).
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses, but lunch & COT = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch ÷ 60 − Set-up Time ÷ 60), for this entry (combined across the machine's day on a locked shift). COT = change-over time, the Set-up Time column.
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Machine Shift − every stoppage; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch − Planned Down Time (the planned stops). Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Total Cycle Time × Actual Quantity ÷ Operating Time, for this entry — how fast it ran against its ideal speed. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong cycle time, quantity or downtime.
quality: Quality = OK Quantity ÷ (OK + Rejected), for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance or Quality is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
partRef: Drawing No., Process, No. of Holes and Stroke Required are the Part's own (Production › Parts), copied onto the entry when the Part is picked.
idealQtyPerHour: IDEAL Quantity/Hour = IDEAL Quantity ÷ Machine Shift Time (hours)
actualQty: Actual Quantity — every piece run (OK + Rejected), typed on the form.
efficiency: Efficiency (%) = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time (hours), for this entry.
